person.name: Samik Roy
person.bioHtml:
With over 30 years of leadership experience spanning global technology giants such as Microsoft and Oracle, Samik Roy brings to RS Software a rare blend of strategic vision, operational excellence, and transformative execution. His career is distinguished by successfully leading Billion-dollar businesses, driving bold innovation, and delivering sustained hypergrowth across diverse products, industries, and market segments. Widely recognized for his expertise in AI, digital transformation, revenue management, and global partnerships, Samik has a proven track record of orchestrating business turnarounds and positioning organizations for long-term success. His leadership has consistently earned global recognition for each of the businesses that he has led at Microsoft.

At RS Software, Samik serves as Chief Operating Officer, where he spearheads global revenue, strategy, product innovation, international partnerships, and project delivery. His focus is on reinforcing RS Software’s position as a trusted partner to national payment systems, core digital infrastructure, and financial institutions in India and worldwide.

Beyond RS Software, Samik serves as a Non-Executive Director on the Board of EmployWise™, an AI-driven HR SaaS product company. His leadership extends beyond the corporate realm, and he is on the Advisory Council of Breakthrough™, a non-profit organization dedicated to eradicating violence and discrimination against women and girls.

prev.name: Peter Sweers
prev.bioHtml:
Peter is the president of Level19, a Toronto based technology consulting, solution delivery and end to end product development firm. Prior to Level19, Peter served as CIO/COO at Interac Corp, Canada’s largest and most trusted payment brand, where he led the modernization of people, process, and technology. He has over 25 years of experience at organizations like Scotiabank, Foresters & CGI leading organizational systems and culture transformations focused on eliminating technical debt, driving growth, digital transformation, and cloud enablement, while increasing employee satisfaction and optimizing organizational efficiencies.

Peter has been recognized in the Business community as one of the Top 25 Most Influential CIOs in Canada by IT World Canada and Canada’s top Tech Titans in 2019 which recognizes the most prominent innovative technology leaders from across the country.

He believes in the integration of strategic advice, coaching, and mentorship, and by leveraging his expertise, he can support senior executives and emerging leaders in driving change, business transformation, and in achieving execution excellence. He is a passionate speaker and has served on several charitable boards, supporting various causes including Ronald McDonald Children’s Charities and the Nanaimo Credit Union Board, and the Board of the York Regional Safety Village and involved with Choices Grade Nine School Program and a leader for the United Way.

next.name: Vijendra Surana
next.bioHtml:
Vijendra Surana has extensive managerial experience in the finance, accounting and capital management areas. His more than 17 years of experience has helped to build a comprehensive understanding of the financial needs of an organization, strategies and tactics required to ensure business continuity for customers, and corporate governance, practices which build a strong foundation for all statutory compliances. His experience and qualifications make him adept at managing the cost structure of an organization working in a global environment.

At RS Software he is responsible for all of financial accounting, budgetary management, capital structure, treasury functions, and legal compliances. Mr. Surana is an accredited Chartered Accountant (FCA), Company Secretary (ACS) and Cost Accountant (AICWA), and is a qualified MBA.
